scope: Job CPU covers active and exited owned descendants; coordinator CPU is measured separately. Residual system/background CPU is an asynchronous, quantized rolling estimate, not application attribution, OS isolation, thermal certification or a bound on individual move contention.

job_before.terminated_count_semantics: Job-limit terminations only; not all normal process exits.
job_before.offset_semantics: Diagnostics only. Not automatically added to Job CPU.
